sandbachFocus: Sandbach United secured a 1-0 victory over visiting Eccleshall on Saturday, with Josh Fowles' early strike proving decisive despite playing the second half with ten men following Hatton's sin bin. The Ramblers, currently in 3rd place with 19 points, showed resilience to hold on and extend their unbeaten run, though they had no further fixtures listed for the coming week.
divisionWide: Title-contenders AFC Bridgnorth (2nd, 19 points) face Brereton Social at home, where they currently trail 1-0 from an own goal on 26 minutes—a shock scoreline against the league leaders' imperious form. Stafford Town (3rd, 19 points), also competing at the top, suffered a dramatic collapse at Cheadle Heath Nomads, going down 2-1 by half-time and now reduced to ten men after Efford's second yellow in the 63rd minute, though they mounted a comeback to level at 2-2 with the match still ongoing. Wolverhampton Casuals continue their push with a commanding 3-1 performance against Shawbury United, while Bilston Town dominated Market Drayton Town 3-0 in a one-sided affair. Allscott Heath defeated Alsager Town 3-1 in a dominant display, New Mills fell 2-1 to Dawley Town despite a spirited comeback, Telford Town lost 1-0 to Barnton, Crewe faced Wednesfield Community, and Foley Meir's fixture against Widnes Town was also scheduled—reflecting a full weekend of division action with significant movement likely in the standings.
